ApplyPage.title: Before you start
ApplyPage.description: Here are some things you should know before starting the application process
ApplyPage.1Heading: Applying requires a one time fee of 250 KSh
ApplyPage.1Description: This fee doesn’t guarantee admittance, it’s for processing your application
ApplyPage.2Heading: You will need some form of ID
ApplyPage.2Description: You will need to upload a picture of either your National ID, Birth Certificate or Alien ID
ApplyPage.3Heading: If you don’t have any form of ID
ApplyPage.3Description: You will need to contact the institution directly and discuss options for applying. The institution contact are on the institution page
